code-resolve-latest-client-server-prefer:
# shellcheck shell=bash
# Bash on the HOST. Resolves the latest Co-op release (or COOP_VERSION),
# downloads matching client + dedicated-server assets, and does not start a server.
# Requires curl. Uses jq when available, otherwise python3.
# Optional: COOP_VERSION=v0.1.7 (or 0.1.7) to match an older host.
# Optional: COOP_STAGE=/path/to/staging  COOP_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1  COOP_CLIENT_MODULE=/path/to/Modules/Coop
(
  set -euo pipefail
  command -v curl >/dev/null || { printf '%s\n' 'curl is required.'; exit 1; }
  ARCHIVER=''
  if command -v 7zz >/dev/null; then ARCHIVER=7zz
  elif command -v 7z >/dev/null; then ARCHIVER=7z
  fi
  if [ "${COOP_SKIP_DOWNLOAD:-0}" != 1 ] && [ -z "$ARCHIVER" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Install 7z or 7zz first.'; exit 1
  fi
  API_REPO='https://api.github.com/repos/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop'
  UA='coop-linux-guide'
  if [ -n "${COOP_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    TAG_RAW="${COOP_VERSION#v}"
    TAG="v${TAG_RAW}"
    API_URL="${API_REPO}/releases/tags/${TAG}"
  else
    API_URL="${API_REPO}/releases/latest"
  fi
  TMPDIR_RES="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR_RES"' EXIT
  HTTP_CODE="$(curl -sS -L -A "$UA" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
    -o "$TMPDIR_RES/release.json" -w '%{http_code}' "$API_URL" || true)"
  case "$HTTP_CODE" in
    200) ;;
    403|429)
      printf '%s\n' "GitHub API rate limit or forbidden (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE}). Wait, set a token, or open https://github.com/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop/releases"
      exit 1 ;;
    404)
      printf '%s\n' "Release not found (HTTP 404) for ${API_URL}. Check COOP_VERSION or the releases page."
      exit 1 ;;
    *)
      printf '%s\n' "GitHub release lookup failed (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE:-000}). Check network and https://github.com/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop/releases"
      exit 1 ;;
  esac
  RESOLVE_PY="$TMPDIR_RES/resolve.py"
  cat > "$RESOLVE_PY" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
release = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
out = Path(sys.argv[2])
tag = release.get("tag_name") or ""
body = release.get("body") or ""
assets = release.get("assets") or []
def asset(patterns):
    for a in assets:
        name = a.get("name") or ""
        if any(re.search(p, name, re.I) for p in patterns):
            digest = a.get("digest") or ""
            sha = digest.split(":", 1)[1] if digest.startswith("sha256:") else ""
            return {"name": name, "url": a.get("browser_download_url") or "", "sha256": sha, "bytes": a.get("size")}
    return None
client = asset([r"^BannerlordCoop-v?[\d.]+\.zip$", r"BannerlordCoop.*\.zip$"])
server = asset([r"DedicatedServer.*Win64.*\.7z$", r"DedicatedServer.*\.7z$", r"BannerlordCoop-DedicatedServer.*\.7z$"])
manifest = asset([r"^manifest\.json$"])
# Prefer published manifest for CDN names/hashes when GitHub omits the large DS asset.
man = None
man_urls = []
if manifest and manifest["url"]:
    man_urls.append(manifest["url"])
man_urls += re.findall(r'https?://[^\s)\"]+/manifest\.json', body)
for u in man_urls:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(u, headers={"User-Agent": "coop-linux-guide"}), timeout=60) as r:
            man = json.loads(r.read().decode())
            break
    except Exception as e:
        err = str(e)
        continue
else:
    err = "no manifest"
if man:
    tag = man.get("tag") or tag
    if man.get("client"):
        c = man["client"]
        client = {"name": c.get("name") or (client or {}).get("name") or "", "url": c.get("url") or (client or {}).get("url") or "", "sha256": c.get("sha256") or (client or {}).get("sha256") or "", "bytes": c.get("bytes")}
    if man.get("windows"):
        s = man["windows"]
        server = {"name": s.get("name") or (server or {}).get("name") or "", "url": s.get("url") or (server or {}).get("url") or "", "sha256": s.get("sha256") or (server or {}).get("sha256") or "", "bytes": s.get("bytes")}
# Body fallback for CDN links + SHA lines when assets/manifest are incomplete.
if not client or not client.get("url"):
    m = re.search(r'(https?://[^\s)\"]+/(BannerlordCoop-v?[\d.]+\.zip))', body, re.I)
    if m:
        client = {"name": m.group(2), "url": m.group(1), "sha256": "", "bytes": None}
if not server or not server.get("url"):
    m = re.search(r'(https?://[^\s)\"]+/(BannerlordCoop-DedicatedServer[^\"\s]*?\.7z))', body, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'(https?://[^\s)\"]+/(?:[^\"\s]*DedicatedServer[^\"\s]*\.7z))', body, re.I)
    if m:
        server = {"name": m.group(2), "url": m.group(1), "sha256": "", "bytes": None}
def fill_sha(item, label):
    if not item or item.get("sha256"):
        return
    # Example body form: SHA-256: `deadbeef...` near the asset label.
    pat = re.compile(re.escape(item["name"]) + r'.*?SHA-256:\s*`([0-9a-f]{64})`', re.I | re.S)
    m = pat.search(body)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'SHA-256:\s*`([0-9a-f]{64})`', body, re.I)
        # only accept if unique-ish; leave empty if ambiguous
        all_shas = re.findall(r'SHA-256:\s*`([0-9a-f]{64})`', body, re.I)
        if label == "client" and len(all_shas) >= 1:
            item["sha256"] = all_shas[0]
        elif label == "server" and len(all_shas) >= 2:
            item["sha256"] = all_shas[1]
        return
    item["sha256"] = m.group(1)
fill_sha(client, "client")
fill_sha(server, "server")
if not tag or not client or not client.get("url") or not server or not server.get("url"):
    raise SystemExit("Could not resolve client and dedicated-server download URLs from the GitHub release/manifest.")
result = {"tag": tag if tag.startswith("v") else f"v{tag}", "client": client, "server": server}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result))
print(json.dumps(result))
PY

  DS_SHA="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["server"].get("sha256") or "")' "$TMPDIR_RES/resolved.json")"
  printf '%s\n' "Resolved Co-op release: ${TAG}"
  printf '%s\n' "Client asset: ${CLIENT_NAME}"
  printf '%s\n' "Dedicated server asset: ${DS_NAME}"
  printf '%s\n' "Releases: https://github.com/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop/releases"
  STAGE="${COOP_STAGE:-$HOME/Games/coop-staging-${TAG}}"
  mkdir -p "$STAGE"
  cd "$STAGE"
  printf '%s\n' "$TAG" > RESOLVED_VERSION.txt

      IFS='|' read -r KIND NAME URL SHA <<<"$SPEC"

        printf '%s\n' "Downloading ${KIND}: ${NAME}"
        curl -fL --retry 2 -A "$UA" -o "$NAME.part" "$URL"
        mv -n "$NAME.part" "$NAME"
      else
        printf '%s\n' "Using existing file: ${NAME}"
      fi
      ACTUAL="$(sha256sum -- "$NAME" | awk '{print $1}')"
      if [ -n "$SHA" ]; then
        printf '%s  %s\n' "$SHA" "$NAME" | sha256sum --check
      else
        printf '%s\n' "No published checksum for ${NAME}; computed sha256: ${ACTUAL}"
      fi
    done
  fi
  if [ "${COOP_SKIP_DOWNLOAD:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "Resolve-only mode: skipped download/extract. Staging metadata in $STAGE"
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ -z "$ARCHIVER" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Install 7z or 7zz first.'; exit 1; fi
  if [ ! -e server ]; then

    "$ARCHIVER" x "$DS_NAME" -oserver
  fi
  test -f server/BannerlordCoopServer.exe

    python3 - <<'PY' "$CLIENT_NAME" client-module
import sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
zpath, dest = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as z:
    z.extractall(dest)
print('Extracted client archive to', dest)
PY
  fi

  COMPARE_CLIENT="${COOP_CLIENT_MODULE:-$STAGE/client-module/Coop}"

import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
tag, client_root, server_root = sys.argv[1:4]
tag_norm = tag.lstrip("v")
sub = Path(client_root) / "SubModule.xml"
print("Server release tag:", tag)
if not sub.is_file():
    print("WARNING: client SubModule.xml not found at", sub)

    raise SystemExit(0)

exe = Path(server_root) / "BannerlordCoopServer.exe"
print("Server executable present:", exe.is_file())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bash: export these four absolute paths from your verified manual launch first:
# SERVER_DIR, PROTON, COOP_PREFIX (dedicated prefix), COOP_DATA_DIR.
# COOP_SERVICE_UNIT and COOP_SERVICE_CONFIG can select isolated test names.
(
  set -euo pipefail
  : "${SERVER_DIR:?Set the verified server folder}"
  : "${PROTON:?Set the verified proton executable}"
  : "${COOP_PREFIX:?Set a dedicated Proton prefix}"
  : "${COOP_DATA_DIR:?Set the intended server data folder}"
  UNIT_NAME="${COOP_SERVICE_UNIT:-coop-server.service}"
  CONFIG_DIR="${COOP_SERVICE_CONFIG:-$HOME/.config/coop-server}"
  case "$UNIT_NAME" in
    coop-server.service|coop-server-*.service) ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' 'Use coop-server.service or a new coop-server-*.service unit name.'; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$UNIT_NAME" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*) exit 1 ;; esac
  for path in "$SERVER_DIR" "$PROTON" "$COOP_PREFIX" "$COOP_DATA_DIR" "$CONFIG_DIR"; do
    case "$path" in /*) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'All paths must be absolute.'; exit 1 ;; esac
  done
  WINE_SERVER="${COOP_WINESERVER:-${PROTON%/*}/files/bin/wineserver}"
  test -x "$WINE_SERVER"
  command -v script >/dev/null
  test -x "$PROTON"
  test -f "$SERVER_DIR/BannerlordCoopServer.exe"
  if [ ! -f "$COOP_DATA_DIR/eula.txt" ] || ! awk '
    tolower($0) ~ /^[[:space:]]*eula[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true([[:space:]]|$)/ {ok=1}
    END {exit !ok}
  ' "$COOP_DATA_DIR/eula.txt"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'EULA consent required: review bundled EULA.md and LICENSE.txt.'
    printf '%s\n' 'Run the server interactively and decide yourself before installing a service.'
    printf '%s\n' 'Do not automate acceptance or copy a different server acceptance file.'
    exit 1
  fi
  UNIT="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/$UNIT_NAME"
  test ! -e "$UNIT" || { printf '%s\n' 'Unit already exists: refusing overwrite.'; exit 1; }
  test ! -e "$CONFIG_DIR" || { printf '%s\n' 'Config folder exists: refusing overwrite.'; exit 1; }
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" "$CONFIG_DIR" "$COOP_PREFIX" "$COOP_DATA_DIR"
  {
    printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n'
    printf 'export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH=%q\n' "${STEAMROOT:-$HOME/.local/share/Steam}"
    printf 'export STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH=%q\n' "$COOP_PREFIX"
    printf 'export STEAM_COMPAT_APP_ID=261550 SteamAppId=261550 SteamGameId=261550\n'
    printf 'unset PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND\n'
    printf 'cd %q\n' "$SERVER_DIR"
    printf 'export SHELL=/usr/bin/bash\n'
    printf -v LAUNCH '%q run %q --data-dir %q --no-watchdog' "$PROTON" "$SERVER_DIR/BannerlordCoopServer.exe" "Z:$COOP_DATA_DIR"
    printf 'exec script --quiet --return --flush --command %q /dev/null\n' "$LAUNCH"
  } > "$CONFIG_DIR/run.sh"
  chmod 700 "$CONFIG_DIR/run.sh"
  {
    printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n'
    printf 'export WINEPREFIX=%q\n' "$COOP_PREFIX/pfx"
    printf 'exec %q -k\n' "$WINE_SERVER"
  } > "$CONFIG_DIR/stop.sh"
  chmod 700 "$CONFIG_DIR/stop.sh"
  cat > "$UNIT" <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Bannerlord Co-op dedicated server
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash "$CONFIG_DIR/run.sh"
ExecStop=/usr/bin/bash "$CONFIG_DIR/stop.sh"
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=30
TimeoutStopFailureMode=kill
Restart=no

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
  systemd-analyze --user verify "$UNIT"
  systemctl --user daemon-reload
  printf 'Installed %s. Review its data configuration before starting it.\n' "$UNIT_NAME"
)
# Run separately after reviewing configuration (substitute your unit name):
# systemctl --user start coop-server.service
# systemctl --user status coop-server.service --no-pager
# journalctl --user -u coop-server.service --no-pager -n 40
# systemctl --user stop coop-server.service
# systemctl --user restart coop-server.service
# Before stopping a real server, save safely using its console.
# Prefix-scoped Wine cleanup is not a substitute for saving.
# Never share this dedicated prefix with another server.
# Stop only this new unit before deleting its own unit/config files.
ai-prompt-pre:
You help set up Bannerlord Co-op on Linux. This prompt is self-contained for the normal supported path. Full HTML/MD guide is optional reference only (advanced/systemd/Discord notes) — do not require fetching it.

Linux setup guide for Bannerlord Co-op. Legitimate Steam Bannerlord required. Do not redistribute game files. Steam Deck is not officially supported (experimental; use Desktop Mode only).

GOAL: same Co-op release for client module + Windows dedicated server; configure; launch under Proton (desktop) or WineHQ 11.0+Xvfb (headless validated here — NOT a proven minimum); open UDP join port(s); confirm real log line containing [DedicatedServer] SERVING. Socket bind alone ≠ clients can join.

SAFETY (always): Ask before sudo, stopping a live server, deleting/overwriting CoopData/saves, or flatpak override. Use placeholders ($HOME, <your-password>, <server-name>). Never paste real passwords/tokens/home paths into public chats. Prefer scoped Flatpak filesystem overrides (server dir), avoid --filesystem=home. Quote all paths. No curl|sh. Backup CoopData before changes. Do not invent STEAMROOT or GAMEDIR.

DLC/MODS: Baseline = Co-op ON, and War Sails, Birth and Aging Options, and Fast Mode OFF until an official release explicitly supports them on dedicated servers. Matching mods/DLC across players is necessary but NOT sufficient for compatibility. Prefer ONE install source (Workshop XOR manual module) — not both. Client Co-op version must match server (server pins Co-op SHA at boot). Game build must match that release’s notes.

PLATFORM DECISION (ask user first; do not auto-install Steam GUI; do not silently override their chosen Steam format with the first path candidate):
- Native Steam → $HOME/.local/share/Steam or $HOME/.steam/steam if steamapps exists.
- Flatpak com.valvesoftware.Steam → $HOME/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam. Tool-package tests ≠ Flatpak Steam GUI PASS.
- Snap → optional/unverified; needs snapd+first launch; candidates under $HOME/snap/steam/common|current/… with steamapps.
- Steam Deck/SteamOS → Desktop Mode only; existing Steam; do not unlock SteamOS. Docs-only / unsupported officially.
- Distrobox: tools may be in container; STEAMROOT/launch on HOST via distrobox-host-exec. Package-container PASS ≠ Steam GUI.
If Steam missing: user installs via supported method. Do NOT promote unvalidated auto-install as proven.

DETECT STEAMROOT (only candidates for the chosen format; confirm with user if several match):
# After user picks format, test only that format’s paths; export STEAMROOT when steamapps exists.
: "${STEAMROOT:?Set STEAMROOT to the chosen Steam client root ( steamscripts / steamapps parent )}"
export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH="$STEAMROOT"
export SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-$HOME/Games/BannerlordCoop-DedicatedServer}"
export UDP_PORT="${UDP_PORT:-4200}"
# Next UDP 4201 also used by Discord direct-IP guidance — open with main port when firewalling.
export UDP_PORT_NEXT=$((UDP_PORT + 1))
unset PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND

GAMEDIR (client module install — may differ from STEAMROOT if secondary Steam library):
- Read "$STEAMROOT/steamapps/libraryfolders.vdf" and appmanifest_261550.acf for the library path that actually contains Bannerlord, OR ask the user to confirm the folder with Bannerlord.exe / Modules/.
- export GAMEDIR="…/steamapps/common/Mount & Blade II Bannerlord" only after that confirm. Never guess; never assume $STEAMROOT/steamapps/common/….
- Client module path: "$GAMEDIR/Modules/Coop"

PREFIX (dedicated server) — do NOT default-write the shared game compatdata:
- Prefer a fresh separate Proton/Wine prefix (e.g. $HOME/Games/BannerlordCoop-Prefix or a dedicated compatdata path). Init with wineboot/Proton once.
- Use existing game prefix "$STEAMROOT/steamapps/compatdata/261550" ONLY if the user explicitly permits writing that prefix.
- export STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH="<chosen-prefix-parent>"   # parent of pfx/ for Proton; or set Wine WINEPREFIX
- export STEAM_COMPAT_APP_ID=261550 SteamAppId=261550 SteamGameId=261550

Keys: saveName, password (or empty), port (=$UDP_PORT, default 4200), steam (see below). Accept EULA on first run — user decision before any service unit.

steam flag: "steam": true only means “try Steam integration if a Steam client is present”. Dedicated-server Steam lobby/listing under Wine/Proton is UNVERIFIED here. Do not promise Steam Join works for DS. Prefer documenting steam:false + direct IP for dedicated hosts; player-hosted Steam invites are a different path.

TOOLS on host where Proton/Wine runs: curl, 7z|7zz, ss|lsof; optional ufw/firewalld. Install only missing tools with user OK.

OBTAIN MATCHING ASSETS (same release tag for BOTH):
1) GET https://api.github.com/repos/Bannerlord-Coop-Team/BannerlordCoop/releases/latest (or /releases/tags/vX.Y.Z if COOP_VERSION set). UA coop-linux-guide. On 403/429 wait or use browser releases page.
2) Prefer release manifest.json (asset or URL in body) for CDN names/sha256 when GitHub omits large DS.
3) Client: BannerlordCoop-*.zip. Server: *DedicatedServer*.7z (Win64). Follow CDN from manifest/body — do not invent URLs.
4) Download both; verify sha256 when provided; extract server → "$SERVER_DIR"; install client module → "$GAMEDIR/Modules/Coop" (backup first).
5) Confirm SubModule.xml Co-op <Version> matches chosen tag. Never mix client/server tags.
Optional pin: COOP_VERSION=v0.1.7 (example — re-check /releases/latest). SteamCMD is NOT the Co-op CDN downloader; never put Steam password on CLI.

LAUNCH (ask user):
A) Proton/GE: PROTON from compatibilitytools.d or Steam Proton. cd "$SERVER_DIR" && "$PROTON" run ./BannerlordCoopServer.exe (name per layout) using the CHOSEN dedicated prefix — not a broad write into the game prefix unless permitted.
B) Headless validated outline: WineHQ wine 11.0 + Xvfb; wineboot -u on fresh prefix; xvfb-run -a wine BannerlordCoopServer.exe from complete DedicatedServer layout. Stock Wine 8 FAIL. Wine 9/10 untested. Optional podman-compose + tianon/wine:11.0.0 in full guide.
C) umu-launcher only if user already uses it.

VERIFY: export UDP_PORT if unset; log shows [DedicatedServer] SERVING; ss -ulnp | grep -E ":($UDP_PORT|$UDP_PORT_NEXT)\\b". SERVING ≠ remote join proof.

FIREWALL (ask first): allow UDP $UDP_PORT and $UDP_PORT_NEXT (Discord direct-IP: 4200–4201 when defaults). ufw allow ${UDP_PORT}:${UDP_PORT_NEXT}/udp  OR firewall-cmd --add-port=${UDP_PORT}-${UDP_PORT_NEXT}/udp --permanent && firewall-cmd --reload. CGNAT/NAT may still block — don’t overpromise.

CLIENT: Launch via Steam; enable Co-op (+ Native/SandBox as required). Prefer direct IP:$UDP_PORT for dedicated steam:false. Do not promise DS Steam lobby. Same Co-op version; keep unsupported DLC/mods off for baseline.

TROUBLESHOOT (no guarantees): SteamAPI_Init → Steam ready; no UDP while “active” → read logs; exit 4 / mismatch → same-tag reinstall; can’t connect → forward/CGNAT/firewall + steam:false direct IP; host+play same PC may stall; watchdog stutter = optional Discord note.

OPTIONAL ADVANCED (full guide): systemd --user after manual OK; OpenRC/runit DIY; Workshop copy of DedicatedServer files (no saves); Docker/Podman Wine11 without privileged/docker.sock.

USER DECISIONS: Steam format; STEAMROOT vs GAMEDIR confirm; dedicated vs permitted game prefix; Proton vs Wine; UDP_PORT; password/saveName; steam true/false (with DS lobby caveat); firewall; sudo; stop existing server; EULA; Deck experimental.

code-dockerfile-wine-11-0-validated-outl:
# Validated outline (guide tests): WineHQ Wine 11.0 + Xvfb.
# Stock Debian Wine 8.0 failed SERVING (stack overflow) — do not use apt "wine" 8.x as E2E.
# Wine 9/10 not tested here; 11.0 is the validated version, not a proven floor for every release.
# Build/run from a complete DedicatedServer Workshop/GitHub layout (not a lone exe).
# Option A — pin the tested image (amd64):
FROM docker.io/tianon/wine:11.0.0
USER root
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends     xvfb xauth ca-certificates winbind && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Option B — Debian trixie + WineHQ winehq-stable (= 11.0.0 when validated):
# follow https://wiki.winehq.org/Debian then install winehq-stable xvfb winbind
ENV WINEPREFIX=/data/pfx WINEARCH=win64 WINEDLLOVERRIDES=mscoree,mshtml=
WORKDIR /server
# Prefer: wineboot -u once on a fresh prefix, then:
CMD ["xvfb-run", "-a", "-s", "-screen 0 1024x768x24 -extension MIT-SHM",      "wine", "BannerlordCoopServer.exe", "--data-dir", "/data", "--no-watchdog"]
code-compose-wine-11-0-rootless-podman-o:
# compose.yaml — rootless podman-compose / Docker Compose compatible outline.
# Validated engine in guide tests: rootless Podman + Wine 11.0 image (not Docker Engine).
# No privileged mode, no docker.sock mounts, no added capabilities.
services:
  coop:
    image: docker.io/tianon/wine:11.0.0
    # Or: build: .  using the Dockerfile above (adds xvfb/winbind).
    network_mode: host
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
    environment:
      WINEPREFIX: /data/pfx
      WINEARCH: win64
      WINEDLLOVERRIDES: mscoree,mshtml=
      DISPLAY: ":99"
    volumes:
      - ./DedicatedServer:/server:ro
      - ./isolated-data:/data
    working_dir: /server
    command:
      - wine
      - BannerlordCoopServer.exe
      - --data-dir
      - /data
      - --no-watchdog
    # Provide Xvfb on the host (Xvfb :99 -extension MIT-SHM) or a sibling service
    # sharing the host network namespace. Do not publish only TCP; allow UDP join port.
    # Console: podman compose attach coop   (or docker compose attach coop)
    # Stop/restart only this project; never a live host service on UDP 4200.
